heading_en: Special Exclusion from Calculation of the ILM
summary_ja: 現在のリスク特性に無関係な内部損失データ上の損失を、承認を得てILMの算出から除外できる特例を定める。
summary_en: Allows, with approval, exclusion from the ILM calculation of operational risk losses in the internal loss data that are irrelevant to the current risk profile.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may, where it has obtained the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, exclude from the calculation of the ILM operational risk losses in its internal loss data that are irrelevant to its current risk profile.
